content:
We are pleased to announce that @Pietro Monticone's LeanProject repo template, which has been adopted by many formalization projects for its convenience and ease-of-setup, is now under the leanprover-community organization. We are excited to continue working with Pietro to improve the experience of formalization projects in Lean.

We recommend updating any links pointing to the previous repo (pitmonticone/LeanProject) to leanprover-community/LeanProject, though they should automatically redirect.
If you have any questions or issues, please post them in the new dedicated thread here: #ecosystem infrastructure > LeanProject repo template
